changes.content:
name: CI/CD Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore: ['e2e/**']
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: 'checks: run the pull-request checks on the dispatched branch'
        required: false
        default: checks
        type: choice
        options: [checks]
      pull-request:
        description: 'Pull request number whose checks are dispatched (informational)'
        required: false
        type: string
      release_mode:
        description: 'Manual release mode (checks runs no release job)'
        required: false
        type: choice
        default: checks
        options:
          - checks
          - instant
          - changelog-pr
      bump_type:
        description: 'Version bump type'
        required: false
        default: patch
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
      description:
        description: 'Release description (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
  GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: init.defaultBranch
  GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: main
  CARGO_NET_RETRY: '10'
  CARGO_HTTP_MULTIPLEXING: 'false'
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  FORMAL_AI_CI_VERBOSE: ${{ vars.FORMAL_AI_CI_VERBOSE || 'false' }}
  FORMAL_AI_NON_LINUX_CI: ${{ vars.FORMAL_AI_NON_LINUX_CI || 'skip' }}
  RUSTFLAGS: -Dwarnings
  CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN || secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
  CARGO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_TOKEN }}
  GHCR_IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
  DOCKERHUB_IMAGE: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_IMAGE || 'konard/formal-ai' }}
jobs:
  detect-changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-detect-changes
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    outputs:
      rs-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.rs-changed }}
      toml-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.toml-changed }}
      docs-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.docs-changed }}
      workflow-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.workflow-changed }}
      pipeline-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.pipeline-changed }}
      agentic-routing-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.agentic-routing-changed }}
      any-code-changed: ${{ steps.changes.outputs.any-code-changed }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - name: Detect changes
        id: changes
        env:
          GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          GITHUB_EVENT_BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
          # A fragment waiting on main runs lint/test/build, so Auto Release runs (#1064).
          RELEASE_PIPELINE: 'true'
        run: rust-script scripts/detect-code-changes.rs
  changelog:
    name: Changelog Fragment Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-changelog
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, build-artifacts]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - name: Check for changelog fragments
        env:
          GITHUB_BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: rust-script scripts/check-changelog-fragment.rs
  docker-build:
    name: Docker Image Build & Runtime Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: read
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-docker-build
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, build-artifacts]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Skip when identical inputs already passed
        id: ledger
        uses: ./.github/actions/green-ledger
        with:
          check: docker-image
          paths: >-
            rust/src data rust/build.rs rust/Cargo.toml rust/Cargo.lock Dockerfile docker scripts .github/workflows/release.yml .github/actions
          enabled: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
      - name: Free up runner disk space
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: bash scripts/free-runner-disk.sh
      - uses: ./.github/actions/download-formal-ai-binary
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-buildx-resilient
      - name: Build image
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        # Issue #1076: a step-level cap reports an overrun as a step *failure*;
        # the job cap reports it as `cancelled` and turns nothing red. 15m is
        # 1.7x the worst of thirteen measured pull-request builds (8.6 min).
        timeout-minutes: 15
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          load: true
          tags: formal-ai:pr-check
          # Publish jobs keep the default `compile`, so what ships is still
          # built from source (issue #1051).
          build-args: BINARY_SOURCE=prebuilt
          cache-from: type=gha,scope=docker-image
          # Issue #1057: prebuilt binary, nothing worth caching; exports were
          # evicting sccache from the shared 10GB pool.
          cache-to: type=inline
      - name: Verify image runtime contract
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          docker run --rm --privileged formal-ai:pr-check verify-formal-ai-dind
      - name: Log in to GHCR for the released upgrade fixture
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        uses: docker/login-action@v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Test released-to-candidate memory upgrade
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: experiments/issue_982_memory_upgrade/run_container_upgrade.sh
      - if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: scripts/prune-docker.sh
  docker-slim:
    name: Slim Docker build and runtime
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-docker-slim-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, build-artifacts]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/docker-slim.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
  secrets-scan:
    name: Secrets Scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-secrets-scan
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.docs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Check for secrets
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref || github.event.before || 'HEAD~1' }}
        run: bash scripts/check-secrets.sh
  version-check:
    name: Version Modification Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-version-check
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - name: Check for manual version changes
        env:
          GITHUB_EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          GITHUB_HEAD_REF: ${{ github.head_ref }}
          GITHUB_BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: rust-script scripts/check-version-modification.rs
  release-preflight:
    name: Release Preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-release-preflight
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Probe every release credential
        env:
          PREFLIGHT_MODE: >-
            ${{ ((github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
            || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
            && github.event.inputs.release_mode == 'instant'
            && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'))
            && 'release' || 'report' }}
          PREFLIGHT_VERBOSE: ${{ env.FORMAL_AI_CI_VERBOSE == 'true' && '1' || '0' }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DOCKERHUB_USERNAME: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME || secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME || 'konard' }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: bash scripts/preflight-credentials.sh
  base:
    concurrency:
      group: check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-base
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pin-base-commit.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
  lint:
    name: Lint and Format Check (lane ${{ matrix.lane }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-lint-${{ matrix.lane }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, base]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.docs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.workflow-changed == 'true'
      )
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Simulate fresh merge with base branch (PR only)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          BASE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.base.outputs.commit }}  # issue #1017: see `base`
        run: bash scripts/simulate-fresh-merge.sh
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-sccache
      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version-file: .bun-version
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - uses: ./.github/actions/cache-cargo-registry
      - name: Run registered gates (stage rust)
        # Issue #991: the gate list lives in data/meta/ci-gates/, one file per
        # gate, so adding a gate no longer edits this file.
        env:
          FILE_SIZE_WARNING_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
          GITHUB_BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          CI_GATE_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
        run: rust-script scripts/run-ci-gates.rs --stage rust
      - name: Build Rust→WASM worker
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: sh js/wasm-worker/build.sh
      - name: Upload rebuilt WASM worker
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-worker-wasm
          path: js/formal_ai_worker.wasm
          retention-days: 3
      - name: Run registered gates (stage wasm)
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: rust-script scripts/run-ci-gates.rs --stage wasm
      - name: Install web bundle dependencies
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build web vendor bundle
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: bun run build:web
      - name: Check web bundles are current
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: git diff --exit-code -- js/vendor.bundle.js js/web-search-component.bundle.js js/ocr.bundle.js js/app.js
      - name: Setup Node
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: rust/tests/e2e/package-lock.json
      - name: Install web test dependencies
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        run: npm ci --prefix rust/tests/e2e --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Run registered gates (stage web)
        if: matrix.lane == 1
        env:
          GITHUB_BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
        run: rust-script scripts/run-ci-gates.rs --stage web
  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.test-suite }})${{ matrix.shard && format(' shard {0}/{1}', matrix.shard, matrix.shards) || '' }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-test-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.test-suite }}-${{ matrix.shard || 1 }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, base, build-artifacts]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # Five parallel shards of the full lane, planned longest-first from
          # data/meta/test-durations.lino (run 37802763478: 296-743s of tests
          # at four). The entry without `shard` is shard 1 (data + census
          # gates); default-feature doc tests run in their own prepared job.
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: full, shards: 5 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: full, shard: 2, shards: 5 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: full, shard: 3, shards: 5 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: full, shard: 4, shards: 5 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: full, shard: 5, shards: 5 }
          # The specification suite on Linux closes the blind spot of issue
          # #1107. PR #1188 runs it as four shards of the prebuilt unit
          # executable (its longest test took 520s; run 37802763478 ran three
          # shards in 417-590s plus a 220-362s compile each). Its unsharded
          # macOS leg is gone: issue #1059 runs on macOS only the tests whose
          # behaviour can differ from Linux (data/meta/macos-platform-tests.lino,
          # macos-core-tests.yml), and a 3600s compile-and-run leg could not fit
          # the 30-minute cap.
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: specification, shard: 1, shards: 4 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: specification, shard: 2, shards: 4 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: specification, shard: 3, shards: 4 }
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, test-suite: specification, shard: 4, shards: 4 }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Simulate fresh merge with base branch (PR only)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          BASE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.base.outputs.commit }}  # issue #1017: see `base`
        run: bash scripts/simulate-fresh-merge.sh
      - name: Skip non-Linux while non-Linux CI is switched off
        id: non_linux
        if: ${{ !startsWith(matrix.os, 'ubuntu') && vars.FORMAL_AI_NON_LINUX_CI != 'run' }}
        env:
          LEG: ${{ matrix.os }} / ${{ matrix.test-suite }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "::notice title=$LEG skipped::non-Linux CI is switched off (issue #1111); set FORMAL_AI_NON_LINUX_CI to run to restore it"
          printf '### %s: skipped, not run\n\nNothing on this platform was verified. Set FORMAL_AI_NON_LINUX_CI to run to restore it (issue #1111).\n' "$LEG" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Skip when identical inputs already passed
        id: ledger
        if: ${{ steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/green-ledger
        with:
          check: unit-tests-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.test-suite }}${{ matrix.shard && format('-shard-{0}', matrix.shard) || '' }}
          paths: >-
            rust/src rust/tests data rust/examples rust/build.rs rust/Cargo.toml rust/Cargo.lock scripts .github/workflows/release.yml .github/actions
          enabled: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
      - name: Free up runner disk space
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        run: bash scripts/free-runner-disk.sh
      - name: Setup Rust
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: wasm32-unknown-unknown
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-sccache
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
      - uses: ./.github/actions/cache-cargo-registry
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        with:
          restore-only: 'true'
      - name: Check LiNo data integrity
        if: ${{ (matrix.test-suite == 'full') && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' && !matrix.shard }}
        env:
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 780
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 70
        run: |
          scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh \
            "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "LiNo data integrity" \
            cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --test unit data_files -- --nocapture
      - name: sccache counters after the first compiling step
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        run: sccache --show-stats
      - name: Check self-AST census freshness
        if: ${{ (matrix.test-suite == 'full') && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' && !matrix.shard }}
        env:
          # Issue #1081: 153s worst measured over 39 runs.
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 300
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 70
        run: |
          scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh \
            "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "self-AST census" \
            cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --test unit self_ast_census -- --nocapture
      - name: Download test executables
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --disable-warning=DEP0005
        with:
          name: formal-ai-test-executables
          path: dist/tests
      - uses: ./.github/actions/download-formal-ai-binary
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
      - name: Run tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (matrix.test-suite == 'full') && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        env:
          # PR #1188: five shards planned longest-first; run 37802763478 ran
          # four in 296-743s, so a fifth of the work is about 450s and 1080s
          # holds it at about 42%. The benchmark corpus gate runs in its own
          # workflow (benchmark-corpus-gate.yml), skipped by run-prebuilt-tests.sh.
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 1080
          TEST_SUITE: full
          SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.shard || 1 }}
          SHARD_TOTAL: ${{ matrix.shards }}
          # PR #1188: seconds a shard spends in other steps (shard 1 the LiNo and
          # census gates; run 37802763478), planned around.
          SHARD_RESERVED_SECONDS: 1=330
          RECORD_TEST_TIMES: ${{ vars.FORMAL_AI_RECORD_TEST_TIMES == 'true' }}
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 70
        run: |
          chmod +x dist/tests/*
          scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh \
            "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "Test suite" \
            bash scripts/run-prebuilt-tests.sh
      - name: Run specification tests from the prebuilt executable
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (matrix.test-suite == 'specification') && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' && steps.non_linux.outputs.skip != 'true' }}
        env:
          # The longest specification test took 520s and three debug shards
          # 417-590s (run 37802763478); four release shards fit well inside 1080s.
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 1080
          TEST_SUITE: specification
          SHARD_INDEX: ${{ matrix.shard || 1 }}
          SHARD_TOTAL: ${{ matrix.shards }}
          RECORD_TEST_TIMES: ${{ vars.FORMAL_AI_RECORD_TEST_TIMES == 'true' }}
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 70
        run: |
          chmod +x dist/tests/*
          scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh \
            "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "Specification test shard" \
            bash scripts/run-prebuilt-tests.sh
  doc-tests:
    name: Default-feature documentation tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    needs: [detect-changes, base]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-doc-tests
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out the actual pull request source
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out the triggering commit
        if: github.event_name != 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Simulate fresh merge with base branch (PR only)
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
          BASE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.base.outputs.commit }}
        run: bash scripts/simulate-fresh-merge.sh
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-sccache
      - uses: ./.github/actions/cache-cargo-registry
        with:
          prefix: doc-tests-
      - name: Prepare default-feature documentation dependencies
        env:
          TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS: 1080
          TEST_WARN_RATIO_PERCENT: 70
        run: |

          fi

          gh release upload "v$RELEASE_VERSION" "${files[@]}" prepared-release-SHA256SUMS.txt --repo "$REPO" --clobber
      - name: Resolve Pages deploy ref
        id: release_pages_ref
        if: always()
        run: |
          sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          echo "sha=${sha}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          rust-script scripts/get-version.rs
  changelog-pr:
    name: Create Changelog PR
    concurrency:
      group: formal-ai-repository-writes
      queue: max
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release_mode == 'changelog-pr' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Create-pull-request pushes the generated release branch after workflow_dispatch, so issue #1079 retains persist-credentials for that action.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - name: Install rust-script
        run: bash scripts/install-rust-script.sh
      - name: Create changelog fragment
        env:
          BUMP_TYPE: ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }}
          DESCRIPTION: ${{ github.event.inputs.description }}
        run: rust-script scripts/create-changelog-fragment.rs --bump-type "$BUMP_TYPE" --description "$DESCRIPTION"
      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: add changelog for manual ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }} release'
          branch: changelog-manual-release-${{ github.run_id }}
          delete-branch: true
          title: 'chore: manual ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }} release'
          body: |
            This PR was created by a manual workflow trigger to prepare a **${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }}** release.
            - **Type:** ${{ github.event.inputs.bump_type }}
            - **Description:** ${{ github.event.inputs.description || 'Manual release' }}
            - **Triggered by:** @${{ github.actor }}
            1. Review the changelog fragment in this PR
            2. Merge this PR to main
            3. The automated release workflow will publish to crates.io and create a GitHub release
  test-e2e-local:
    name: E2E Tests (local web app)
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-test-e2e-local
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true'
      )
    uses: ./.github/workflows/e2e-local.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
  test-agent-cli-e2e:
    name: E2E Tests (agent CLI ↔ formal-ai)
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-test-agent-cli-e2e
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [detect-changes, build-artifacts]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    uses: ./.github/workflows/agent-cli-e2e.yml
    with:
      full-replay: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.detect-changes.outputs.agentic-routing-changed == 'true') }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
  build-artifacts:
    name: Build binaries and tests
    outputs: {source-commit: "${{ steps.source.outputs.commit }}"}
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-build-artifacts
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [detect-changes]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Free up runner disk space
        run: bash scripts/free-runner-disk.sh
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-sccache
      - uses: ./.github/actions/cache-cargo-registry
        with:
          prefix: artifacts-
      - name: Pin actual native test producer source commit
        id: source
        run: printf 'commit=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Build binaries and test executables
        run: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release --no-run --bins --tests --all-features
      - name: Collect the build artifacts
        run: bash scripts/collect-build-artifacts.sh
      - name: Bind native test artifacts to their actual build inputs
        run: node scripts/native-test-artifact.mjs write dist/tests release all
      - name: Capture complete current native agentic protocols
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: node scripts/capture-native-agentic-protocol.mjs "$RUNNER_TEMP/native-agentic-protocol-captures" dist/formal-ai
      - name: Upload actual native agentic protocol captures
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: native-agentic-protocol-captures
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-agentic-protocol-captures
          retention-days: 3
      - name: Upload formal-ai binaries
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-release-binary
          path: dist/*
          retention-days: 1
      - name: Upload test executables
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-test-executables
          path: dist/tests
          retention-days: 1
  native-response-observations:
    needs: [build-artifacts]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.build-artifacts.result == 'success' }}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/native-response-observations.yml
    with:
      source-commit: ${{ needs.build-artifacts.outputs.source-commit }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
  box-language-projects:
    name: Box Image Projects (${{ matrix.language }})
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-box-language-projects-${{ matrix.language }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    needs: [detect-changes, build-artifacts]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.any-code-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.rs-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.toml-changed == 'true' ||
        needs.detect-changes.outputs.pipeline-changed == 'true'
      )
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        # Kept in step with `data/meta/box-language-projects.lino` by `tests/unit/ci-cd/box_language_release_legs.rs`.
        language: [rust, python, javascript, typescript, go, java, ruby]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Skip when identical inputs already passed
        id: ledger
        uses: ./.github/actions/green-ledger
        with:
          check: box-project-${{ matrix.language }}
          paths: >-
            rust/src data rust/build.rs rust/Cargo.toml rust/Cargo.lock experiments/box_language_projects scripts .github/workflows/release.yml .github/actions
          enabled: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
      - name: Free up runner disk space
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: bash scripts/free-runner-disk.sh
      - uses: ./.github/actions/download-formal-ai-binary
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
      - name: Generate the ${{ matrix.language }} project from Formal-AI answers
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: scripts/generate-box-language-corpus.sh ${{ matrix.language }}
      - name: Build and run it inside its link-foundation/box image
        if: ${{ steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        run: STRICT=1 SKIP_GENERATE=1 scripts/verify-box-language-projects.sh ${{ matrix.language }}
      - name: Upload the generated project
        if: ${{ (always()) && steps.ledger.outputs.already-green != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: box-language-corpus-${{ matrix.language }}
          path: target/box-language-corpus/${{ matrix.language }}/
          retention-days: 7
          # `always()` also covers a leg that failed before generating anything.
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: scripts/prune-docker.sh
  build-pages:
    name: Build GitHub Pages artifact
    concurrency:
      group: formal-ai-pages-build-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true
    needs: [build, auto-release, manual-release]
    if: |
      !cancelled() &&
      needs.build.result == 'success' && (
        (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.auto-release.result == 'success') ||
        (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release_mode == 'instant' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.manual-release.result == 'success')
      )
    uses: ./.github/workflows/pages-artifact.yml
    with:
      sha: ${{ needs.auto-release.outputs.pages_sha || needs.manual-release.outputs.pages_sha || github.sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
  deploy-pages:
    name: Deploy Web App to GitHub Pages
    concurrency:
      group: formal-ai-repository-writes
      queue: max
    needs: [build-pages]
    outputs:
      page_url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
      pages_sha: ${{ needs.build-pages.outputs.pages_sha }}
    if: |
      !cancelled() &&
      needs.build-pages.result == 'success' && (
        (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') ||
        (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release_mode == 'instant' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
      )
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Configure GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v6
      - name: Deploy Pages artifact
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v5
        with:
          timeout: 600000
        env:
          # deploy-pages upstream issue #434 tracks its core punycode deprecation.
          NODE_OPTIONS: --disable-warning=DEP0040
  test-e2e-pages:
    name: E2E Tests (GitHub Pages)
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-test-e2e-pages
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [deploy-pages]
    if: |
      !cancelled() &&
      needs.deploy-pages.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: rust/tests/e2e/package-lock.json
      - name: Install Playwright and dependencies
        run: |
          cd rust/tests/e2e
          npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Cache Playwright browsers
        id: playwright-cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/ms-playwright
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-${{ hashFiles('rust/tests/e2e/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-playwright-
      - name: Install Playwright system dependencies (best effort)
        timeout-minutes: 6
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          cd rust/tests/e2e
          npx playwright install-deps chromium
      - name: Install Playwright browsers
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: |
          cd rust/tests/e2e
          npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Wait for GitHub Pages deployment
        env:
          PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA: ${{ needs.deploy-pages.outputs.pages_sha || github.sha }}
        run: scripts/wait-for-pages-deployment.sh "${{ needs.deploy-pages.outputs.page_url }}" "$PAGES_DEPLOY_SHA"
      - name: Run GitHub Pages e2e tests
        run: |
          cd rust/tests/e2e
          PAGES_URL="${{ needs.deploy-pages.outputs.page_url }}" npx playwright test --config=playwright.pages.config.js
      - name: Upload Playwright report on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: playwright-report-pages
          path: rust/tests/e2e/playwright-report/
          retention-days: 7
  native-container-images:
    name: Native full and slim container publication
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-native-container-images
      cancel-in-progress: false
    needs: [auto-release, manual-release]
    if: |
      !cancelled() && (
        (github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
         needs.auto-release.result == 'success' && needs.auto-release.outputs.container-tag != '') ||
        (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.release_mode == 'instant' &&
         github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && needs.manual-release.result == 'success' && needs.manual-release.outputs.container-tag != '')
      )
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/container-images.yml
    with:
      push: true
      tag: ${{ needs.auto-release.outputs.container-tag || needs.manual-release.outputs.container-tag }}
  pipeline-status:
    name: Pipeline Status
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: always()
    needs: [detect-changes, changelog, docker-build, docker-slim, secrets-scan,
            version-check, release-preflight, base, lint, test, doc-tests, macos-core-tests, build,
            auto-release, manual-release, native-container-images,
            changelog-pr, test-e2e-local, test-agent-cli-e2e,
            build-artifacts, native-response-observations, box-language-projects, build-pages, deploy-pages,
            test-e2e-pages, server-parity]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Fail the run when a required job was cancelled or failed
        env:
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          IS_MAIN: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push' }}
        run: bash scripts/check-pipeline-status.sh
